query_excerpt: Party B shall pay one-month freight as liquidated damages in case of termination of the Agreement without consent.

Unless otherwise approved by Party A, in the event of parcel transfer due to Party B's vehicle delay, Party B shall pay liquidated damages to Party A at the standard rate of RMB500 per trip on the first working day, RMB…
In addition to vehicle personnel insurance, Party B shall at least purchase injury insurance for two persons with coverage not lower than RMB500,000 per person.
The coverage of third-party liability insurance shall not be lower than RMB1 million.
